revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 11.8% but is decelerating as UNH reprices/exits unprofitable plans; fade to ~4% near long-run healthcare spend growth.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 4.2% (18,964/447,567), down from 8.1% in FY2023/FY2024; assume partial recovery to 5.5% flat, still well below history. UNH is flagged a financial company by the data tool; a standard FCF DCF is a rough approximation.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: ~21% federal plus state; normalized 23% (FY2025 implied effective rate lower, ~18%).

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM cost of equity = 4.86% 10Y UST (Treasury 2026-11-06) + ~0.85 beta (assumed) x 4.46% US ERP (Damodaran 2026-02-16) = ~8.7%; after-tax cost of debt ~4.5%; ~25% debt weight gives ~7.6-8%; 8.0% used.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: lowered from 3.0% to 2.5% to reduce terminal value dependence (flagged at 79% of EV); well below 4.86% risk-free rate and nominal GDP. A 5-year horizon on a mature, low-growth business inherently leaves TV the bulk of value.
